accessibility.aria_label: Trump signs executive order to reshape college sports landscape

content.text:
Trump signs executive order to reshape college sports landscape
The order grants the NCAA the ability to limit athlete transfers, cap player eligibility, implement funding requirements for women and Olympic sports, and prohibit NIL collectives.
